releaseNotes:
### Desktop and Local Files

- Preview the split desktop distribution with the existing app identity, local data location, and update channel controls.
- Open local HTML pages in the browser workspace and resolve chat and project file links consistently, with scoped file access.
- Keep transcript position and message pairing more stable across session changes, streaming, and reloads.

### Models and Command Approvals

- Improve per-session model and reasoning controls, including model catalog synchronization, availability, and cost metadata.
- Reuse narrowly scoped command approvals within a session and inspect or revoke them from the session controls.
- Strengthen command argument and shell policy checks while supporting local development servers.

### Project Activity and Upgrade

- Preserve project activity ordering when sessions are archived or deleted and when project metadata changes.
- Upgrade project activity metadata with a transactional v18-to-v19 database migration and an automatic pre-upgrade backup.
- This preview shares the stable app's data directory; returning to version 0.3.4 requires restoring the pre-upgrade database backup.
